scope: Root inspected all four final-package opening Art Institute and McCormick day/night bookmark stills at 1600x1000.
findings: Art Institute departure retains the Modern Wing roof fins, glazed frontage and continuous city context. Night fixtures and skyline windows remain visible; fine glass/roof grain remains.
McCormick Lakeside terrace meets the mapped shore without the former ground wedge. Recessed glazing, dark steel envelope, North pylons, South curved edge and hotel cluster remain legible.
Night McCormick uses modest promenade, pylon and window illumination. Broad roofs and open water remain dark; night brightness is an authored interpretation.
